notes.full: The full run: five bosses, then the Root Process at 15:00. Ranked on the leaderboard.
notes.short: The same run, compressed: bosses at 1:36, 2:40, 4:00, 5:20 and 6:40, the Root Process at 8:00. Not ranked.
notes.siege: Defend the core in the middle of the map. Enemies go for whichever is closer, you or the core. Every 15 kills earns a part: press T or tap ▲ to build a turret. The Root Process comes at 10:00. Not ranked.
notes.story: Five chapters narrated by the Relay, each with its own goal. Finish one to unlock the next.
notes.training: A sandbox. You cannot be hurt, nothing spawns on its own, and nothing is earned. Use the bar at the top to level up, spawn enemies and bosses, and jump ahead in time.

daily.overcharged: Overcharged: powers recharge twice as fast
daily.elites: Elite rush: elites come twice as often
